subject.title: feat: add plugin verify evidence endpoint

question: Should this public plugin verify endpoint expose only selected-release evidence, or may it also expose current package-level trusted-publisher and verification configuration?
rationale: The answer defines a public trust/security contract for executable plugin releases, and automation cannot safely choose whether mutable package configuration belongs inside version-scoped provenance.

options.title: Release-scoped provenance only
options.body: Return only selected-release verification inside `provenance`, and omit current package-level trusted-publisher config unless it was captured for that release.

options.title: Expose current config separately
options.body: Keep mutable package-level trusted-publisher or verification data out of release provenance and document it as current package configuration.

options.title: Pause behind the RFC
options.body: Leave the draft open until the vetted-community plugin trust RFC settles assurance boundaries and public wording.

recommendation.title: Release-scoped provenance only
recommendation.body: Return only selected-release verification inside `provenance`, and omit current package-level trusted-publisher config unless it was captured for that release.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the clearest current-main owner for the adjacent package trust API surface and has already engaged on this PR.
